body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided audio tour in Chicago, United States. The listing gives its length as 2.5 – 4 hours, over a route of about 1 mile. It starts at Art Institute of Chicago, South Michigan Avenue, 111. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket to the Art Institute of Chicago. There is no live guide: the tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone. WeGoTrip names Alexandra as the tour's author.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Explore the masterpieces of the Art Institute of Chicago with a self-guided audio tour.
>
> Housed in a magnificent Beaux-Arts building on Michigan Avenue, the museum features works by Vincent van Gogh, Claude Monet, Pablo Picasso, Edward Hopper, Georgia O’Keeffe, and many other celebrated artists.
>
> Begin on the 1st floor with the art of Asia, discovering Buddhist and Hindu sculptures and traditions spanning thousands of years. Continue to the art of Ancient Greece, Rome, and the Mediterranean before moving into European painting.
>
> On the 2nd floor, admire iconic Impressionist and Post-Impressionist works by Monet, Renoir, Seurat, Van Gogh, and Toulouse-Lautrec. Discover how these artists transformed the way light, colour, and everyday life were represented.
>
> Continue to the Modern Wing for works by O’Keeffe, Warhol, Matisse, Kandinsky, Picasso, and Dalí. Finally, explore American Modernism with Edward Hopper and Grant Wood, then enjoy panoramic views of Chicago from the Bluhm Family Terrace.
>
> The tour takes approximately 2–3 hours and includes maps and text hints to help you navigate the museum.
>
> Note: General admission is 11 a.m.–5 p.m.; 10–11 a.m. is reserved for members.
>
> This tour is created by an independent creator and is not affiliated with the Art Institute of Chicago. WeGoTrip does not resell museum tickets but assists customers with ticket purchasing at no additional charge.
